nom: Clarins Bright Plus Brightening Vitamin C & Niacinamide Dark Spot Serum

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the serum feels hydrating and non-greasy, and some also mention it as their entry point for tackling hyperpigmentation and early aging signs.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report no irritation and good tolerance, while others describe stinging, dry patches, or breakouts triggered by the fragrance.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing themselves as mature or mid-age report improved skin appearance, texture and fading of age/sun spots.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination-leaning oily skin notes the serum absorbs without an oily feel and works well under makeup.

concerns.spots: Most reviewers using this for dark spots, sun spots, melasma or hyperpigmentation report gradual fading over weeks to months, including melasma on the upper lip and post-fulguration marks; several others report no noticeable change after 30 days to a month of use.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers report the serum helped fade acne scars, breakout marks and hormonal breakout marks; one notes it helped clear a bad breakout-related hyperpigmentation within a month when paired with another serum.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers describe the serum as hydrating and moisturizing without greasiness; one reviewer specifically bought it to address dehydration and dullness alongside dark spots.
concerns.redness: Two reviewers report the serum helped reduce redness without stinging, unlike other serums they had tried.
concerns.aging: Reviewers who mention early signs of aging or being mid-age report improved overall skin appearance and texture, with some citing fading of age/sun spots.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer states the product left her face rough and caused a breakout, and another reports it caused dry patches around the nose, though most others report no barrier issues.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers note the serum absorbs without leaving an oily or greasy feel, useful under makeup, though this is reported mainly as a texture observation rather than an oil-control concern.

extraits.titre: Has fragrance maybe not good for sensitive skin but nice!
extraits.texte: Packaging is super cute and easy to use I did notice a light scent, have very sensitive skin so it did irritate my face a bit. It has a nice smooth texture and absorbs flawlessly. I'm not sure how effective the product is as I did not notice a difference since I couldn't use it everyday due to the irritation from the fragrance. Otherwise it's a very nice product! (I received a free product for my honest review)

I'm not sure it's doing anything, but I have not been consistent. What I have found is that it causes dry patches round my nose, used once a day in the evening. Definitely could not use this every day, and needs to be topped with moisturizer. I do have sensitive skin. It does have a heavy scent. Won't buy it again.

I received the Clarins Bright Plus Brightening Vitamin C & Niacinamide Dark Spot Serum, the newest launch from Clarins, complimentary in exchange for my honest review. All opinions are entirely my own. First off, I really appreciate Clarins' commitment to clean beauty and sustainability. This vegan serum is crafted with 91% natural ingredients and comes in elegant, eco-conscious packaging. As someone with dry skin, my biggest skincare concern is hyperpigmentation from past sun damage (thank you, tanning beds). I also struggle with dehydration, dullness, and early signs of aging—so I was excited to try this serum. It combines vitamin C, niacinamide, and Clarins' proprietary Evenness Technology to target dark spots and improve skin tone. The serum itself feels luxurious: lightweight, milky in texture, with a clean, subtle scent. My skin felt instantly soothed and hydrated—no greasiness, no sticky residue. It layers beautifully with other skincare products without pilling. One note: while I enjoy this product and the visible improvement in my skin's texture and tone, I do hope Clarins reconsiders its stance on animal testing for certain global markets in the near future. That said, I've noticed a real difference. My complexion looks smoother, more radiant, and evenly toned. I've even received compliments on my skin. I'll definitely continue using it and look forward to further fading of dark spots over time. Bottom Line: This serum delivers on its promises. Highly recommend it f

Lifelong Clarins user. I bought this thinking it would lighten the dark spot on my face and neck. Used for 30 days and NO change. I have been more successful with drug store brands that are less than 1/2 the price. I tried to return but they wanted me to pay the postage! Save your money
